text:
maria: quick check — trying to get the SDK working through our VPC ingress/egress setup. We have an internal ingress URL (https://ingress.internal.corp) and an egress proxy for outbound to hosted-redwood (http://egress-proxy:3128). SDK seems to prefer the base_url override but streaming fails mid-request. Anyone seen this?
chris: are you setting X-Forwarded-Host / Host headers? our infra rewrites SNI, so you need to set host header to the public model host. For streaming the chunked transfer gets broken by proxy unless `Connection: keep-alive` is preserved. What SDK/lang?
maria: node SDK (latest). I passed baseURL to RedwoodClient({ baseURL: 'https://ingress.internal.corp' }) and env HTTP_PROXY for egress. streaming starts then stalls after first few tokens.
tyler: in node http(s) proxies, chunked encoding can be buffered by proxy. workaround: set `streaming: { mode: 'raw' }`? there's also an env REDWOOD_PASSTHROUGH_HEADERS=Host,Sni to keep host.
maria: is REDWOOD_PASSTHROUGH_HEADERS real? Where's that documented?
devex-bot: FYI, internal doc link: https://internal.redwood/ingress-proxy#header-passthrough (permissions apply).
chris: it's not in public docs yet. For Node, two things to try: 1) set `headers: { host: 'api.redwood.ai' }` on the client init; 2) disable proxy buffering — for squid/nginx add `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` passthrough and `connection` settings. Example config I used in our staging nginx: 
```
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Connection '';
proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
proxy_buffering off;
```

maria: ok trying. Also—retries: do we want SDK retries to run against ingress (idempotency) or let proxy handle? we got double retries.
tyler: prefer SDK to be aware: set `maxRetries: 2` and `retryOn: ['5xx', 'timeout']` and ensure request idempotency tokens are forwarded. Otherwise proxy might retry at TCP level as well; set `proxy_retry off` in proxy
maria: thanks. I'll open a tiny PR with a snippet and tests. pinging @chris for a quick review.
chris: ping received, will review in ~30m. Also add a unit test that simulates chunked streaming via local nginx container.
maria: awesome — will drop the PR link here when ready.
devex-bot: deploy note: remember to add egress proxy host to allowlist 10.2.0.0/16 per infra ticket #INF-472
maria: added allowlist entry, pushed PR  (1822103540) — PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/789
chris: looked quick — left one nit on header naming. LGTM otherwise. :thumbsup:
tyler: re: streaming issue — we should add a short note to devex docs about proxy buffering. I'll draft.
